source_name: President of Ireland pre-2012 president.ie index.php English speeches (Wayback/CDX)
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 1,039 captures. The TEMPORAL-DEPTH recipe for Ireland - the PRE-2012 site generation, which served both languages off one script switched by a query parameter: index.php?section=5&speech=<id>&lang=eng (English) vs &lang=ire (Irish). Same lesson as Bulgaria's &lang=en - keying the link_pattern on lang=eng isolates the English render. TITLE(h2) clean and usually carries the delivery date ('Arthur Cox Memorial Lecture, UCD, 4 March, 1999'; 'Remarks by President McAleese at the Institute of Designers in Ireland...'); TEXT(div.text) 3.9k-9.7k chars, English confirmed. TWO ENGINE CONSTRAINTS drove the design: (1) filter_entries_for_recipe drops captures whose URL PATH equals a start_url path, and every article here is path /index.php with only the QUERY differing, so start_urls MUST be the bare host (the documented Georgia workaround); (2) a bare-host CDX prefix would return the whole 60k+ site, so the harvest is narrowed SERVER-SIDE by a CDX 'original:.*speech=[0-9]+.*lang=eng.*' filter. Known small losses: a couple of root-form captures (/?section=5&speech=...) are dropped by that same path rule, and 3 of 1,039 rows are lang=eng./lang=eng_Full variants that may duplicate. DATE has NO usable selector and is deliberately left to the cleaner: parsing the h2 is actively harmful because a real title like 'Address ... at the 1916 Commemoration ... Sunday 12th April 2009' makes dateparser return 1916-07-27 (verified locally). NO speaker_default (McAleese dominates; Robinson items appear) -> tenure crosscheck. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
